episodes.title: This Is Where it Begins
episodes.summary: Adam Neumann is a young entrepreneur finding his path in the business world when he meets Rebekah, who inspires him to launch a company.

episodes.title: Masha Masha Masha
episodes.summary: Tying the knot after a whirlwind romance, Adam and Rebekah begin their life together as he expands WeWork and she pursues acting.

episodes.title: Summer Camp
episodes.summary: The growing WeWork team gathers on Rebekah's family property. Rebekah grapples with a public relations misstep and bad personal news.
With Adam's fame growing and WeWork on the rise, Rebekah begins to feel sidelined at home and decides to pursue a new friendship.

episodes.title: Hustle Harder
episodes.summary: After a huge investment, WeWork is firmly in the big leagues—and Adam is ready to take aim at his competition. Rebekah's friendship is strained.

episodes.title: Fortitude
episodes.summary: Chaos at WeWork sends the Neumanns on a retreat to the west coast. Concerns grow about Adam's leadership. Rebekah finds a new focus.

episodes.title: The Power of We
episodes.summary: Rebekah is frustrated with WeGrow's progress while Adam attempts to mend their relationship. They state their mission—and the world reacts.

episodes.title: The One With All the Money
episodes.summary: Series finale. After a disastrous reaction kills the IPO, Adam and Rebekah fight for their lives at WeWork. Adam risks it all in a last-ditch effort.
